## Objective

Construct the positive-parameter outer algebraic action finite part and prove
that it is compatible with central--outer matching and exact branch
composition.

## Proof obligations

- [ ] Determine the exact outer clock and action-density weights.
- [ ] Formulate the reference orbit and fixed-cut/same-compactifying-coordinate
      comparison in physical variables.
- [ ] Prove convergence of the renormalized spatial length and action.
- [ ] Establish the mixed \(C^2\) parameter estimates required by the final
      theorem.
- [ ] Prove independence up to the stated coboundary under admissible changes of
      section, compactifying coordinate, and matching cut.
- [ ] Prove strict additivity with finite central branches before taking the
      noncompact limit.

## Acceptance

Claims V4 and V5 must already be proved.  A finite-cut action is not an
algebraic finite part.
